summary: New internal/gitrun package is the only place that calls exec.Command with "git" (Plain, At, Hardened, Capture); all former call sites in cli, defect, driver, intervention, metrics and runs build their commands through it with their trimming and error text unchanged.
verified: vloop task gate T2 exited 0 (gate T2: ok); go build/vet, gofmt, GOOS=linux/windows builds clean; go test ./... passes with VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset.
notes: Hardening lives only in gitrun.Hardened (driver's gitCmd wraps it); gitPath uses gitrun.At and configEntries gitrun.Plain, both unhardened as before.
